alert_surface_label: Example State official voter-information alert surface
delivery_role_note: Site alerts and interstitials make urgent current-state information visible, but the alert layer does not become the rule source by itself.
placement_policy_note: Use a single prominent treatment for sitewide urgent information and keep narrower issues page-scoped. Avoid stacked sitewide alerts that blur priority.
interruption_policy_note: Use blocking interstitials only when necessary to the design of the experience; most urgent voter information should remain recoverable through nonblocking sitewide or page-scoped alerts.
timeliness_indicator_policy_note: Action-changing alerts include publication dates and, where relevant, effective and expiration dates. Alerts that stop controlling are cleared or explicitly superseded.
stacking_policy_note: Group multiple urgent items inside one alert treatment or supporting links instead of stacking multiple competing banners.
alert_destination_policy_note: Every alert preserves a clear path to the current official destination or help route that actually governs the answer.
